# V2 development experiments (auto-generated by src/v2/run_v2.py)

Config `v2.0-dev`. Dev file only (2010-2024); **2025/2026 were not read.** Tour-level matches: selection folds [2020, 2021, 2022] (6,620 matches), reporting folds [2023, 2024] (5,559). Each fold year is predicted by a model trained on 2015 to the year before. Every model is scored on exactly the same rows. 99.3% of these matches have complete serve/return statistics (the rest still count; they just add no statistics to anyone's profile).

The reporting folds are held out from V2 choices but are **not independent** (PLAN_V2.md section 1).

## 1. All models

`sel_logloss`: mean over selection folds (used for choices). Everything else: pooled reporting folds. `vs_D`: log loss minus Model D's, with a 95% interval from resampling whole tournaments (negative = better than D). Verdict uses the rule fixed in PLAN_V2.md.
